designInputs: current JIT generator offer and evaluator
obligation: The robot must move while the arrow is held and settle promptly when released.
counterexample: The robot travels appreciably in the late portion of the no-input tail.
routeRationale: The 240-tick library holds are blocked or slowed by terrain before release. On clean hold-right x advances 0.184 px in its last held tick and hold-left has already stopped. The shorter pure holds reach full speed on clear floor. Most other library routes jump, shoot, reverse, press another action, or never move.
boundRationale: A full-speed clean release settles within 20 physics ticks. The independent trace observation starts at release plus 24 ticks (200 ms), four ticks after that bound, and allows 1 px horizontal range through release plus 59. The held-motion floor of 100 px is below the calibrated 176.25 px. The paired greater-than comparisons require a 5 px difference given clean references of 10 px. Tail-extension equality allows a 1 px deviation around the clean difference of zero.
generatorLimitation: The parser supplies whole-episode windows, the displacement signal reads the endpoints, and event_response supports projectile_spawn only. The paired endpoints are proxies. The independent trace observation is not a generated predicate and receives no proposal credit.
